scope: Actual common recorder, software command storage, pool translator, submission FIFO, arena, mimalloc, and scheduler on Linux; native services are recording fixtures.
current_code_identity: The edited production bytes listed in current_input_sha256, not a claimed published commit.

source_provenance.method: Discover dependencies with compiler -MM; capture each current input once as bytes; hash and compile the same frozen bytes; resolve the baseline ref to an immutable commit and git-archive its production inputs; verify live current inputs again after execution.

boundaries.profiler_explanation: Only the three unconditional Windows thread-registration APIs are inert. Real ProfileThreadStream.h supplies profiling types; CE_SHIPPING=1 uses the actual disabled ProfileScope/marker definitions. The original ProfileService.h hash is retained below and the compiled override has its separate hash above.

boundaries.allocator_observation: Global new/new[]/aligned new are counted; GNU --wrap observes mi_malloc and mi_malloc_aligned then delegates to the actual vendored mimalloc. Observer calibration requires two standard requests and two real mimalloc requests, including mi_check_owned.

matrix.oracle: Recorded-and-replayed command digests and counts match direct native-boundary calls using the same logical commands. Caller arrays are poisoned after recording; submission order and frame metadata remain the original order.

translation_failure_and_lifetime: Invalid pool state, policy, target capacity, stale upload/descriptor versions, wrong queue/device identity, missing identities, and nonempty output admission.
Acquire/open/close/encoder-drop failures, bool replay failure, native-boundary exception, original-order deterministic failure metadata, and peer target drain before failure return.
Frozen native resource identities survive producer advance; nested synchronous worker join is rejected; one-shot ownership and concurrent disjoint recording are preserved.
Actual FIFO native submission preserves original target order and batch metadata; controlled fence retirement retains owners after CPU submission until completion.
current_only_byte_admission: Oversized arena budget rejection occurs before native completion reservation and before consuming the recorded input.
Queued plus running software bytes block a second producer despite available FIFO slots; completed replay releases CPU credits while GPU lifetime leases remain.
Queued cancellation with distinct owners and same-owner waiters; a deliberately blocked resource destructor proves credits are not returned before cancelled captures are released.
Faulted native submission returns CPU credits while retaining quarantined GPU lifetime until explicit confirmed-error abandonment.
current_structured_failure: Invalid and pending tickets return no diagnostic and reset stale output; completed successful tickets and owners do likewise.
Queued cancellation preserves software recording identity and Admission stage with no native execution uncertainty.
Preflight native rejection and failure after simulated execute retain distinct uncertainty flags; ticket, failure queue and persistent owner copies retain identical structured metadata.
An actual translator bool-command failure carries target, command index, opcode, recording identity and generation through the FIFO without attempting native submission.
coverage.current_existing_commands_probe: The actual current probe additionally checks 8-to-1-to-8 retained storage, bool-budget fallback and successful Begin-to-Seal recording identity with cancellation/new-session identity separation; the baseline uses its own older command probe.

reproduce.dependency: An enkiTS checkout at the pinned commit, plus the tracked mimalloc, Mathematics, and ownership_cpp vendor headers.
reproduce.failure_reporting: A rejected check prints RHI_SOFTWARE_PORTABLE_FAILURE with check count and the contract message. The runner preserves compiler/runtime diagnostics and fails if source hashes change during the gate.

limitations: CPU fixture replaces native device, encoder, queue submission and fence observation only
CE_SHIPPING=1; Windows profiler registration is inert at the explicit boundary
Actual production recorder, command list, translator, FIFO, arena, mimalloc and scheduler bodies are compiled
No Windows Editor, GPU execution, pixels, driver cost, or full-frame performance measured
Sanitizer mode disables LeakSanitizer because the sandbox restricts process inspection
The fake native queue reports controlled completion values; real driver fences, GPU work, pixels, Windows Debug costs, and device recovery are not exercised.
This portable gate covers the common pool translator and FIFO. Owned queue wrappers and native Vulkan/DX12 integration have separate gates.
The newest shared device-incarnation helper is compiled through the real header; this fixture supplies fixed queue identities and does not prove native backend incarnation allocation.
Passing the portable checks does not establish a measured Editor or full-frame speedup.
The native submission fixture controls whether execute was attempted; executionUncertain propagation is tested through the actual FIFO, not through a live driver fault.

CE_SHIPPING=1 compiles the actual disabled telemetry scope. The format consumer gate validates Python decoding and exact-key identity resolution with independent wire fixtures; it does not execute the profiler producer.
